## `docs_add_tab`

Class: create

Add a new tab to a document. Can be a top-level tab or nested as a child of an existing tab.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `title` | string | required | Tab title |
| `parentTabId` | string | optional | Parent tab ID (omit for top-level) |
| `index` | number | optional | Position among siblings |

## `docs_create_named_range`

Class: create

Tag a range of text with a name. Multiple ranges can share the same name. Used as a template anchor for docs_replace_named_range_content.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `name` | string | required | Name (1-256 chars). Need not be unique. |
| `startIndex` | number | required | Range start (inclusive) |
| `endIndex` | number | required | Range end (exclusive) |

## `docs_modify_table`

Class: update

Mutate a table by operation: insertRow, insertColumn, deleteRow, deleteColumn, mergeCells, unmergeCells. Locate the cell with tableStartIndex (the table's start index in the doc) plus rowIndex/columnIndex (0-based).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `operation` | enum | required |  |
| `tableStartIndex` | number | required | Start index of the table in the document |
| `rowIndex` | number | required | Target row (0-based) |
| `columnIndex` | number | required | Target column (0-based) |
| `insertBelow` | boolean | optional | insertRow only: insert below the target row (default: false) |
| `insertRight` | boolean | optional | insertColumn only: insert right of the target column (default: false) |
| `rowSpan` | number | optional | mergeCells only: how many rows the merged cell spans (default 1) |
| `columnSpan` | number | optional | mergeCells/unmergeCells: column span (default 1) |

## `docs_read`

Class: read

Read document content as plain text with a heading index (returns up to maxChars characters per call). Pass heading or headingIndex to read one section, tabId to read a specific tab.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `heading` | string | optional | Read only the section under this heading (case-insensitive; exact match first, then substring) |
| `headingIndex` | integer | optional | Read only the section at this position in the headings array (the `i` field) |
| `tabId` | string | optional | Read a specific tab instead of the first tab |
| `maxChars` | number | optional | Max characters of text to return (default: 50000) |
| `offset` | number | optional | Character offset to continue a truncated read |

## `docs_replace_named_range_content`

Class: update

Replace the content of every named range matching the identifier with the supplied text. Real mail-merge primitive — far more robust than replaceAllText for templated docs.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `namedRangeId` | string | optional | Specific named range ID |
| `namedRangeName` | string | optional | Name to match (replaces ALL ranges with this name) |
| `text` | string | required | Replacement text |

## `docs_replace_text`

Class: update

Find and replace text in a document. Pass findText/replaceText for a single pair, or replacements for several pairs applied in one batchUpdate.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `documentId` | string | required | Google Docs document ID |
| `findText` | string | optional | Text to search for. Use with replaceText; exactly one of this pair or `replacements` is required. |
| `replaceText` | string | optional | Replacement text for findText |
| `matchCase` | boolean | optional | Case-sensitive match (default: true) |
| `replacements` | array | optional | Several find/replace pairs applied in one batchUpdate, each returning its own count. Exactly one of this or findText/replaceText is required. |
